rules.statement: Where a deceased husband leaves acquired property only and has children from a previous marriage, the childless widow is entitled to a life interest in only part of the acquired property.
rules.supporting_quote: "I do not find any comment in the books on Kandyan law showing that no distinction arises from the fact of there being children of a former marriage. It was suggested at the argument that the rule as stated by Marshall had reference only to paraveni property. But that cannot be its meaning, because both paraveni and acquired property are mentioned."
